description: Subtitle processing implementations including functions for quality checking, generation, translation, and validation of subtitle files primarily in SRT format. Provides utilities to normalize, limit caption lines, translate text, generate dummy subtitles, and perform basic validation checks.

methods.name: str run_quality_check_and_correct( subtitle_path: str, video_path: Optional[str], language: Optional[str], enforce_ott: bool, processed_dir: str, )
methods.description: Performs basic validation and normalization on subtitle files, with in-place corrections such as whitespace and timing adjustments, optionally enforcing caption line limits.

methods.name: str generate_subtitles_for_video( video_path: str, language: Optional[str], processed_dir: str, model_hint: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Simulates subtitle generation for a video file by creating placeholder SRT content.

methods.name: str translate_subtitles( subtitle_path: str, target_language: str, source_language: Optional[str], processed_dir: str, model_hint: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Mocks translation of subtitles by appending language code tags to text lines within the subtitle.

methods.name: List[str] validate_subtitles(subtitle_path: str, options: Dict)
methods.description: Runs basic checks on subtitle files for issues like line length, line count per caption, and empty blocks.
